iterations.reason: The wave ownership makes the mechanism incomplete. In this specialization, the four waves produce disjoint KQ key-row tiles, but VKQ work is partitioned by value/output rows, so every consumer wave needs normalized scores produced by the other waves. Wave64 shuffles cannot cross wave boundaries, and exchanging only row max/sum through LDS cannot reconstruct those scores. Avoiding the KQ LDS transpose therefore requires either duplicated KQ computation or a new key-partitioned VKQ scheme followed by cross-wave partial-output exchange, with different accumulator/LDS/VGPR geometry; neither is specified or supported by resource evidence.
